text: 单身的40岁男，都这个年纪了还相亲，肯定想要有孩子，自然不考虑40岁女。
en: A single 40-year-old man who is still going on matchmaking dates at his age surely wants to have children, so naturally he will not consider a 40-year-old woman.

text: 离异的40岁男，还敢出来跟人相亲的，条件一般都不差，也不考虑年龄大的。
en: A divorced 40-year-old man who still dares to go matchmaking generally has decent prospects, and he will not consider an older woman either.

text: 主要问题是在大城市，年轻小姑娘多得是。
en: The main issue is that in big cities there is no shortage of young girls.

text: 好不容易有钱了，你让我找老伴？
en: I have only just managed to get some money, and you want me to find an old companion?

text: 我觉得是40岁女普遍不考虑40岁男。
en: I think it is that 40-year-old women generally do not consider 40-year-old men.

text: 也可以说40岁女普遍不考虑结婚了。
en: One could also say that 40-year-old women generally do not consider getting married any more.

text: 40岁单身的人，离异占绝大多数，已经吃够了婚姻的苦，好不容易离了，基本上也都有了孩子，余生挣钱养娃就好。
en: Among single 40-year-olds, the divorced make up the vast majority; they have had their fill of the misery of marriage, and having finally divorced, they basically all already have children, so for the rest of their lives they just need to earn money and raise the kids.

text: 找个40岁的离异男，给人当后妈？
en: Find a 40-year-old divorced man and become a stepmother to his children?

text: 自己的娃还管不过来呢。
en: I can barely manage my own children as it is.

text: 找个小几岁未婚的，还得给人生个孩子，再来一遍，想想就可怕，还是算了。
en: Find an unmarried man a few years younger, and still have to bear him a child and go through it all over again — just thinking about it is terrifying, so forget it.

text: 40岁未婚女，已经扛过了30岁前后家庭和社会给她催婚压力最大的时候，到了40岁已经随缘了，有合适的就结，没合适的这辈子不结婚也无所谓。
en: An unmarried 40-year-old woman has already weathered the period around thirty when her family and society pressured her hardest to marry; by forty she has learned to let things be — if a suitable match comes along she will marry, but if not, it does not matter if she never marries in this lifetime.

text: 你是瞧不起我的下半身，还是我的上半身。
en: Do you look down on my lower half, or my upper half?

text: 不仅40岁男人不考虑，20岁、30岁男人也不考虑
en: Not only do 40-year-old men not consider them, neither do 20- or 30-year-old men.

text: 高中时喜欢年轻女老师
en: In high school I liked a young female teacher.

text: 大一喜欢学姐
en: In my first year of university I liked a senior female student.

text: 工作几年喜欢刚来单位的小姑娘
en: After a few years at work I liked the young girl who had just joined the unit.

text: ——男人很专一的，一直喜欢20出头的女性
en: —— Men are very single-minded; they always like women just over twenty.

text: 客观讲，40岁以上未婚女性在形象，经济上的平均值，远远大于40岁以上未婚男性平均值。
en: Objectively speaking, the average unmarried woman over forty surpasses the average unmarried man over forty by far, in terms of appearance and finances.

text: 告诉你一个真相，40多岁的女人快绝经了，如果考虑生育价值基本上没有男人去找。
en: Let me tell you a truth: a woman in her forties is nearly menopausal, and if you consider her reproductive value, basically no man will go for her.

text: 如果是丁克的话，要看这女人自身条件是否出众能提供其他方面的价值。
en: If she is a DINK, it depends on whether the woman's own qualities are outstanding enough to offer value in other respects.

text: 40 岁的女人，有的都开始绝经了。
en: A 40-year-old woman — some have already begun menopause.

text: 也不一定
en: Not necessarily.

text: 如果是40岁高圆圆、林志玲或者王心凌的水准
en: If she were at the level of a 40-year-old Yuanyuan Gao, Zhiling Lin, or Xinling Wang,

text: 依然能打
en: she could still hold her own.

text: 两年前的破回答咋突然又这么多人回复
en: Why has this rubbish answer from two years ago suddenly got so many replies?

text: 当时就图一乐
en: I just wrote it for a bit of fun at the time.

text: 算了，留着自打脸玩儿吧
en: Forget it, I will leave it here to slap myself in the face with later.

text: 大家如果有颜值身材不错的40岁大姐
en: Everyone, if you know any good-looking, well-built 40-year-old ladies,

text: 来BJ旅游记得来找我
en: remember to come and find me if you visit BJ.

text: 我请你们吃烤鸭
en: I will treat you to roast duck.

text: 你们独自来也行
en: You can come on your own,

text: 带上你们的闺蜜一起来也行
en: or bring your best friends along too.

text: 昨天邻居非要给我介绍一个在北京打拼的40岁黄花大闺女，我说太老了，邻居直接怼我，你可年轻，又不是大7、8岁。
en: Yesterday my neighbour insisted on introducing me to a 40-year-old virgin maiden working hard in Beijing; I said she was too old, and the neighbour shot right back at me, 'You are young, it is not like she is seven or eight years older.'

text: 人在大城市生活，看着年轻，像30岁。
en: Living in a big city, she looks young, like thirty.

text: 懒得跟她扯那么多了。
en: I could not be bothered to argue with her any further.

text: 不管从生育角度来说，还是我在一个小县城跟大城市的仙女来说，都不是一个合适的对象。
en: Whether from a reproductive standpoint or as a match for me — a fairy from a small county town versus the great city — she is just not a suitable partner.

text: 40岁颜值在线身材在线的女性
en: A 40-year-old woman whose looks and figure are still on point

text: 这些可是稀缺资源，真的轮不到屌丝接盘的
en: these are scarce resources, and really it is not the diaosi's turn to take them on.

text: 至于其他的，小头真的左右大头阿
en: As for the rest, the little head really does call the shots over the big head, eh.

text: 绝大多数男人的择偶标准，都是希望女方尽量年轻。
en: The vast majority of men's criteria for choosing a partner are that the woman should be as young as possible.

text: 甚至有时候，年轻>漂亮。
en: Sometimes, in fact, youth > beauty.

text: 年轻是女性在婚恋市场上最大的优势。
en: Youth is a woman's greatest advantage in the marriage market.

text: 其实用不上40，27以后，女生就不太好找结婚对象了…
en: Actually you do not even need to get to forty; after twenty-seven, a girl starts to struggle to find a marriage partner…

text: 30绝对是一大关。
en: Thirty is absolutely a major threshold.

text: 来看看30岁女博士的血泪心声：
en: Let us look at the heartfelt, bitter words of a 30-year-old female PhD:

text: “我交了一大笔钱，在精英婚介所报了名。
en: "I paid a large sum of money to register at an elite matchmaking agency.

text: 男女比例很不协调，大概是三比七，甚至是二比八——条件好的男人成了香饽饽，甚至都不需要交会费。
en: The male-to-female ratio was very unbalanced, roughly three to seven, even two to eight — men with good conditions became hot commodities, and did not even need to pay membership fees.

text: 婚介所用他们的资料吸引女人们入会…
en: The agency used their profiles to lure women into joining…

text: “我当时都二十九了，虽然往小报了两岁，但在那些男人眼里，依然被四舍五入，自动归类到三十岁的行列。
en: "I was already twenty-nine at the time; although I knocked two years off my age, in those men's eyes I was still rounded up and automatically filed into the thirty-year-old column.

text: 我和婚恋顾问处成了朋友，她很够意思，一有条件合适的男会员，先把我的资料拿给对方看。
en: The matchmaking consultant and I became friends; she was very decent, and whenever there was a suitable male member she would show my profile to him first.

text: 王宏锴往椅子上一靠，扬着下巴问：“见了不少？
en: Hongkai Wang leaned back in his chair, chin lifted, and asked, 'Met quite a few?

text: 栾雅丽却摇了摇头，“给一个三十岁的精英男士看一个快三十岁女人的照片，他们100%会拒绝见面，连1%的希望都没有。
en: Yali Luan shook her head. 'Show a photo of a woman nearly thirty to an elite gentleman of thirty, and they will reject a meeting 100 per cent of the time — there is not even 1 per cent of hope.

text: 因为自身条件优越，他们对女会员的期望值都很高。
en: Because their own conditions are superior, their expectations of female members are very high.

text: 在他们眼里，‘好对象’最关键的标准，是‘尽可能年轻貌美的女性’，生育能力比其他任何方面都重要。
en: In their eyes, the most crucial standard for a 'good match' is 'a woman as young and beautiful as possible'; reproductive ability matters more than anything else.

text: 他们考虑的东西都很现实，超过二十五岁不行，家庭有负担不行，事业心太强也不行…
en: What they consider is all very practical: over twenty-five will not do, a burdensome family will not do, too strong a career ambition will not do either…

text: “那你很受挫吧？
en: 'So you felt quite defeated, then?

text: “确实。
en: 'Indeed.

text: 三十岁，名校博士，如果是个男人，肯定会备受追捧——可如果换成女人…
en: Thirty years old, a PhD from a prestigious university — if it were a man, he would surely be hugely sought after; but if it is a woman…

text: ”栾雅丽顿了顿，苦笑了一下，“没办法，现实就是如此残酷。
en: ' Yali Luan paused, gave a wry smile, and said, 'There is no help for it; reality is just that cruel.

text: ——出自《爱的匹配法》
en: —— From 'The Method of Love Matching'

text: 因为大龄产妇，生育风险更高。
en: Because of advanced maternal age, the risk of childbirth is higher.

text: 要是结婚前就说好不要孩子，那还好。
en: If it was agreed before marriage that there would be no children, that is fine.

text: 但如果还想生孩子，那无论是对产妇还是对孩子而言，都不好。
en: But if they still want to have a child, then it is not good either for the mother or for the child.

text: 我查了一下大龄产妇生孩子的危害：
en: I looked up the dangers of an older woman giving birth:

text: 大龄产妇生孩子可能会出现妊娠期高血压、胎儿畸形、胎儿早产等危害。
en: An older woman giving birth may face dangers such as gestational hypertension, foetal deformity, and premature delivery.

text: 1.妊娠期高血压：大龄产妇的内分泌功能与生殖系统功能可能会降低，在进行生产时，子宫肌层动脉血管可能会出现硬化现象，且大龄产妇的血管弹性会降低，可能会导致产妇出现妊娠期高血压的现象。
en: 1. Gestational hypertension: an older woman's endocrine function and reproductive-system function may decline; during delivery, the arterial blood vessels in the uterine muscle layer may harden, and her vascular elasticity may decrease, which may lead to gestational hypertension.

text: 2.胎儿畸形：大龄产妇的卵巢功能可能会减弱，可能会出现卵子质量低下的状况，在受精卵进行分裂时可能会出现染色体异常的状况，进而可能会导致胎儿畸形。
en: 2. Foetal deformity: an older woman's ovarian function may weaken, leading to poor egg quality; when the fertilised egg divides, chromosomal abnormalities may occur, which in turn may cause foetal deformity.

text: 3.胎儿早产：大龄产妇的卵巢功能可能会降低，因而可能会导致产妇的生育能力降低，因而容易出现胎儿早产的状况。
en: 3. Premature delivery: an older woman's ovarian function may decline, which may reduce her fertility and thus make premature delivery more likely.

text: 所以，大多数想要孩子的男性，希望女方年轻，便于生育更加健康的宝宝。
en: Therefore, most men who want children hope the woman is young, so as to bear healthier babies.

text: 产妇也可以免于更多生育风险。
en: The mother can also be spared greater childbirth risks.

text: 而不想要孩子的男性，之所以也更倾向于年轻女生，大概是因为受“男强女弱”“男大女小”等传统婚恋习惯的影响。
en: As for men who do not want children, the reason they too lean towards younger women is probably the influence of traditional courtship habits such as 'men strong, women weak' and 'older man, younger woman'.

text: 也可能觉得，找个年轻的妻子，带出去“更有面子”。
en: It may also be that they feel taking out a young wife makes them 'look better'.

text: 比如，为什么绝大多数有钱的大叔，都只找年轻漂亮的女生…
en: For example, why do the vast majority of wealthy older men only go for young, pretty girls…

text: 而恰恰一大堆年轻女性，也很愿意找年纪比自己大很多的大叔…
en: yet a great many young women are also quite happy to go for much older men…

text: 我闺蜜，今年二十二岁，就是个彻头彻尾的大叔控。
en: My best friend, twenty-two this year, is a complete uncle fan.

text: 她最近又处了一个四十多岁的男友，在农村都能当她爹了！
en: She has recently taken up with a boyfriend in his forties — he could be her father back in the village!

text: 我曾问过她喜欢大叔的原因，她回答得一板一眼：
en: I once asked her why she likes older men, and she answered with total earnestness:

text: “四十多岁是男人最好的年纪吧，既不会像十几二十几岁那样幼稚，也不会像糟老头那么刁钻油滑。
en: 'One's forties are a man's best years, I suppose — not as childish as the teens and twenties, nor as testy and slick as a decrepit old man.

text: 言外之意是，她以前交往过的两个同龄人在她看来都太幼稚了，所以才改变了线路。
en: What she meant was that the two peers she had dated before seemed too childish to her, which is why she changed course.

text: 可这条路也不是那么好走的啊。
en: But this path is not such an easy one to walk either.

text: 她最近交往过的那个大叔，工作还算体面，属于爱干净、有品位的那种。
en: The older man she has recently been seeing has a fairly decent job, the clean-loving, refined sort.

text: 独居，离过婚，有一个在老家寄宿制学校读书的十五岁的儿子…
en: He lives alone, is divorced, and has a fifteen-year-old son boarding at a school in his hometown…

text: 她曾一脸炫耀地主动给我看过手机里他的照片，
en: She once proudly and unprompted showed me his photo on her phone,

text: 该怎么说呢，就是一个剪着利落短发、一脸平和的中年男子，
en: how to put it — he is a middle-aged man with a neat short haircut and a calm face,

text: 看不出情绪，也看不出什么稀奇之处，整个人都洋溢着一股子从容感——也可能是疲惫感。
en: showing no emotion and nothing remarkable, radiating an air of composure — or perhaps exhaustion.

text: 可就是这样一个面无表情的中年人，被我眼前这个活泼烂漫的小女生不知收敛地爱上了。
en: Yet this expressionless middle-aged man was loved without restraint by the lively, ingenuous young girl before me.

text: 即便她才比对方的儿子大七岁。
en: Even though she is only seven years older than his son.

text: 而被爱的一方，在遭到告白时似乎一点儿都没惊讶，态度平静地点头接受了。
en: And the one being loved showed not the slightest surprise when confessed to, accepting with a calm nod.

text: 就像在接收一份快递。
en: Like receiving a parcel.

text: 她一见到我就跟我讲她在大叔身边的事，我也确实有兴趣听，想看看小小的她是如何应付一个大男人的。
en: The moment she saw me she told me about life by the older man's side, and I was genuinely interested in hearing how such a little thing coped with a full-grown man.

text: 他工作忙，她每周只能去他家里一次，平时都发短信，因为他忙起来时不太方便接她的电话。
en: He is busy with work, so she can only go to his place once a week; usually she texts, because when he is busy it is not convenient for him to take her calls.

text: 可他又很少回她的短信，即便回也都回得很迟很简短。
en: But he rarely replies to her texts, and even when he does it is late and brief.

text: 虽然还没到那年纪，可我似乎也能隐隐体会到，当他看到那些源源不断涌进手机的各种搭讪问候、关心提醒和难以理解的笑话时，会是一种怎样的心情…
en: Though I have not reached that age myself, I seem to vaguely understand what sort of mood he is in when he sees all those endless hellos, caring reminders, and incomprehensible jokes flooding into his phone…

text: 不回或回得少也算情有可原。
en: Not replying, or replying little, is understandable.

text: 大叔每周只休星期日，有时白天还安排了别的事情要出门，下午三四点钟回家都算早的了。
en: The older man only has Sundays off; sometimes he has other errands to go out for during the day, and getting home at three or four in the afternoon counts as early.

text: 而到家之后的时间归他的小朋友所有。
en: And the time after he gets home belongs to his little friend.

text: 他带她出去吃饭，吃了两次之后收到了她的提议：她更希望两个人自己做饭吃。
en: He took her out to eat, and after two such meals she proposed: she would rather the two of them cook for themselves.

text: 他依旧平静地点头，然后默默把一筷头菜塞进嘴里，慢慢咀嚼。
en: He nodded calmly as before, then silently stuffed a mouthful of food in and chewed slowly.

text: 他也的确按照她的意思在家做起了饭，只是省去了两人一起去菜市场买菜的环节，她每次赶到他家时，他已经去超市把食材选购好了。
en: And he did indeed start cooking at home as she wished, only skipping the part where they went to the market together — by the time she rushed to his place, he had already been to the supermarket and bought the ingredients.

text: 她笨手笨脚，似乎帮不上什么忙，就被要求坐在沙发上看电视，或者帮他清理手机里功能重叠的应用。
en: She was all thumbs and seemed unable to help, so she was told to sit on the sofa and watch TV, or to help clear the overlapping apps from his phone.

text: 她说她听到他在厨房开水龙头、切东西、炒菜的声音时，心里感到特别美好，似乎一下子领悟到了什么才是真实的生活。
en: She said that when she heard the sounds of him turning on the tap, chopping, and stir-frying in the kitchen, she felt wonderfully content, as if she had suddenly grasped what real life is.

text: 他无论做什么菜她都赞不绝口，甚至要以吃一大碗饭的形式来表达感激。
en: Whatever he cooked she praised endlessly, even expressing her gratitude by eating a great bowl of rice.

text: 饭后他不让她动手收拾碗筷，依旧让她在客厅里待着，自己又跑到厨房里一顿洗涮。
en: After the meal he would not let her clear the dishes, keeping her in the sitting room as before while he went off to the kitchen to wash up.

text: 然后她摸着吃得很饱的肚子，又在心里觉得特别美好。
en: Then she rubbed her full belly and again felt wonderfully content inside.

text: “这不就是我理想中的那种小日子嘛。
en: 'Isn't this just the little life I have always dreamed of?

text: 他们一起窝在沙发里看电视剧，吃水果，她会趁他不注意时亲他一口，他也会拿勺子挖一口西瓜喂她吃。
en: They would snuggle on the sofa watching TV dramas and eating fruit; she would sneak a kiss when he was not paying attention, and he would scoop up a spoonful of watermelon to feed her.

text: 她还发现他竟然不会用淘宝，就颇有耐心地一步步教他，帮他挑选好看的内裤，然后在旺旺上跟卖家计较邮费…
en: She also discovered he did not even know how to use Taobao, so patiently taught him step by step, helped him pick out nice-looking underpants, and then haggled over postage with the seller on Wangwang…

text: 当然，他也会在洗完澡后温柔地将她抱上床，像老虎逮住小兔子一样压住她，再铺天盖地般吻下去。
en: Of course, after his shower he would gently carry her to bed, pin her down like a tiger seizing a little rabbit, and then kiss her all-consuming.

text: 那一刻她觉得时间凝固，整个世界的喧嚣戛然而止，就好像他在不紧不慢地把那份平静灌输进她的身体，让她也体会到了岁月的安稳。
en: In that moment she felt time freeze, the world's noise coming to an abrupt halt, as if he were slowly infusing that calm into her body, letting her taste the steadiness of the years.

text: 是的，跟大叔在一起的时候她全身心都愉悦。
en: Yes, with the older man she was wholly happy.

text: 但一段时间过后她并不满足于此，她总觉得这种关系缺少了太多应有的元素，比如听对方说一句“我爱你”，一件突如其来的小礼物，一次惊喜的特别安排…
en: But after a while she was not satisfied with this; she always felt the relationship lacked too many of the things it ought to have — like hearing him say 'I love you', a sudden little gift, a surprise special arrangement…

text: 总之就是那些能被定义为“浪漫”的种种。
en: In short, all those things that can be defined as 'romance'.

text: 大叔依旧很忙，依旧不回她的短信。
en: The older man remained busy, still not replying to her texts.

text: 他们依旧每周只见一次面，他依旧陪她一起看电视剧、吃水果，却不再给她做饭了，而是像一开始一样带她出去吃——
en: They still met only once a week; he still kept her company watching dramas and eating fruit, but he no longer cooked for her — instead he took her out to eat as at the start —

text: 他给出的理由那么实在、直接、不容反驳：
en: and his reason was so practical, direct, and impossible to argue with:

text: “要买菜、洗菜、做菜，还要收拾，太麻烦了，也太浪费时间了。
en: 'You have to buy the vegetables, wash them, cook them, and then tidy up — too much trouble, and too much of a waste of time.

text: 她却在心里把这事儿无限放大了，甚至脑洞大开揣测出了N种可怕的可能，但其实都指向一个结论——
en: But she blew the matter out of all proportion in her mind, even letting her imagination run wild to conjure up N possible terrifying scenarios, yet they all pointed to one conclusion —

text: 他不爱她了。
en: he no longer loved her.

text: 于是，从前那个温顺安分的小白兔不见了，她不再给大叔发短信，而是一遍遍打电话，对方就一遍遍按掉不接。
en: So the meek, well-behaved little white rabbit of before disappeared; she stopped texting the older man and instead rang him again and again, and he pressed reject and did not answer, again and again.

text: 几次过后对方终于接了，语气有些怨怼地问她到底有什么要紧的事儿，她也没好气地说：
en: After several tries he finally picked up, asking with a touch of resentment what on earth was so urgent, and she answered tersely:

text: “难道没事儿就不能给你打电话吗？
en: 'Can't I call you if there is nothing wrong?

text: ”然后先挂了。
en: ' then hung up first.

text: 星期日见面时她突然对大叔说：“你好像从来都没说过你爱我”。
en: When they met on Sunday she suddenly said to the older man, 'You seem to have never said you love me.'

text: 大叔正在看报纸，只从嗓子眼儿里发出一声低沉的“嗯”，像是在回应，又好像不是。
en: The older man was reading the newspaper and only let out a low 'mm' from the back of his throat, as if responding, yet perhaps not.

text: 她突然来了情绪，好像非得为自己据理力争些什么才肯消停，拿开报纸看着大叔的眼睛让他说一句“我爱你”。
en: She suddenly got worked up, as if she would not rest until she had fought her corner, and pulled the newspaper away to look into the older man's eyes, demanding he say 'I love you'.

text: 大叔没说什么，反而被她一脸的严峻样儿逗乐了。
en: The older man said nothing, and was instead amused by her solemn expression.

text: 她态度坚决，又急又气，都快哭了，好不容易才从他嘴里撬出一句听上去干瘪生涩的“爱你”。
en: She was resolute, anxious and angry, nearly in tears, and only with great difficulty pried a dry, awkward-sounding 'love you' out of him.

text: 隔周过后她买了生鸡翅中和冷冻薯条要为他下厨，他说太麻烦了，不如还是出去吃吧。
en: The following week she bought raw chicken wings and frozen chips to cook for him, but he said it was too much trouble and they might as well eat out.

text: 她执意不肯，已经把鸡翅放到盆里开始洗了。
en: She insisted, having already put the wings in a basin and started washing them.

text: 他难以阻止，只好挽起袖子准备帮忙，却被要求在沙发上坐着。
en: Unable to stop her, he rolled up his sleeves to help, only to be told to sit on the sofa.

text: 他有点儿无奈，也有些担心，动不动就晃到厨房门口瞧瞧，一遍遍嘱咐她别烫到手。
en: A bit helpless and a bit worried, he kept wandering to the kitchen door to peek, repeatedly telling her not to burn her hands.

text: 可乐鸡翅
en: Cola chicken wings

text: 和炸薯条上桌了，她兴高采烈地夹给他，一脸成就感，就等着他的夸奖。
en: and fried chips were served; she cheerfully placed some on his plate, face full of achievement, just waiting for his praise.

text: 他吃了一口可乐鸡翅，样子有点儿犹豫，然后说：
en: He took a bite of the cola chicken wings, hesitated a little, then said:

text: “我平时都不吃鸡翅，给鸡打针都往翅膀上打——炸薯条也对身体不好。
en: 'I do not normally eat chicken wings; the injections they give chickens all go into the wings — and fried chips are not good for the body either.

text: 她的笑脸一下子塌了，在他平静认真的语气里感到了某种绝望。
en: Her smiling face fell at once, and in his calm, serious tone she sensed a kind of despair.

text: 大叔总能指出她一些不好的生活习惯，还动不动就讲一些枯燥的人生道理，
en: The older man was always pointing out her bad habits, and would often drone on with dull life lessons,

text: 语重心长得像个父亲，怎么看都不像个恋人，这让她十分苦恼。
en: weighing his words like a father, nothing like a lover however you looked at it, which distressed her greatly.

text: 终有一天她耐不住性子了，在大叔给她讲如何跟同事相处时突然淡淡地说了一句“我们分手吧”，还装得很不经意。
en: One day she lost her patience; as the older man was telling her how to get on with colleagues, she suddenly said lightly, 'Let us break up,' pretending it was offhand.

text: 她以为大叔这下子肯定会慌，会一脸急切地使劲挽留她，可事与愿违，大叔只沉默了一会儿，然后依旧很平静地说了声“哦”。
en: She thought the older man would surely panic and urgently try hard to keep her, but things went against her wishes — he was silent for a moment, then said calmly as ever, 'Oh.'

text: 她是哭着从大叔家里跑出去的，他一点儿都没拦她，却在她摔门走掉前说了句“到家给我来个短信”。
en: She ran out of his home in tears; he did not stop her at all, but before she slammed the door and left he said, 'Text me when you get home.'

text: 她哭得更欢了，也顾不得路人的眼光，抹着眼泪一路小跑，好在她家离着不远。
en: She cried even harder, ignoring the looks of passers-by, wiping her tears as she trotted along — fortunately her home was not far.

text: 她到家后也没给他发短信。
en: She did not text him even after getting home.

text: 临睡前大叔打来了电话，她接起来却不说话，只听见一个平静的声音像在自言自语：
en: Just before sleep the older man called; she answered but said nothing, only hearing a calm voice as if talking to himself:

text: “哦，接电话了，看来没事儿，我得早点儿睡。
en: 'Oh, you picked up — seems all is well, I should sleep early.

text: 然后大叔就把电话挂了。
en: Then the older man hung up.

text: 她原本好不容易才平静下来，却怎么也想不到对方竟然就这样把电话挂掉了，汹涌的悲伤喷薄而出。
en: She had only just managed to calm down, yet never imagined he would simply hang up like that; a surge of sorrow burst forth.

text: 然后就没有然后了。
en: And then there was no afterwards.

text: 这事儿着实伤她不轻，我能从她的眼神和语气里捕捉到茂盛的哀怨和残存的爱意。
en: This matter truly hurt her deeply; I could catch, in her eyes and tone, lush resentment and lingering affection.

text: 我劝她可以借由此事的结果把“择偶”的年龄标准修订一下，她却撅着嘴一声不吭。
en: I advised her that, in light of how this turned out, she might revise her age standard for choosing a partner, but she just pouted and said nothing.

text: 经过一番犹豫，她终于厚着脸皮问我这个旁观者，大叔到底爱不爱她。
en: After some hesitation, she finally plucked up the nerve to ask me, a mere onlooker, whether the older man truly loved her.

text: 为了助她赶紧死心，我脱口而出：“应该不爱吧。
en: To help her give up quickly, I blurted out, 'Probably not.

text: ”然后叹了口气。
en: ' then sighed.

text: 其实，那个大叔也未必不爱她，只是不同性别、不同年龄、不同心态的人表达爱的方式大不一样。
en: In fact, that older man may not have been without love for her; it is just that people of different sexes, ages, and mindsets express love in very different ways.

text: 他眼里的爱可能就是那种不刻意说出“我爱你”，不用费尽心思玩浪漫的安静陪伴。
en: The love in his eyes may have been that quiet companionship which does not deliberately say 'I love you' or trouble itself to play at romance.

text: 只是这点她还不懂，他也不好意思说出来让她懂——
en: It is only that she did not understand this, and he was too embarrassed to say it and make her understand —

text: 他知道那样太难为她了，终究不是二十出头的人该去理解的事儿啊。
en: he knew that would be too much to ask of her; after all, it is not something someone just over twenty ought to understand.

text: 而且，这个大叔连儿子都有了，早就过了跟小姑娘谈情说爱的年纪，用心去经营一段鲜活的感情对他来讲未免太棘手、太奢侈也太有风险。
en: Moreover, this older man even has a son, and long passed the age for whispering sweet nothings with a young girl; for him to earnestly nurture a fresh romance would be too thorny, too luxurious, and too risky.

text: 本就都是平凡的人，人生到了那样的阶段，该有的差不多都有了，不想再拥有太多，更不愿意再失去什么，本本分分地固守现状是他们眼中最要紧的事，再经不起什么变数了。
en: They were ordinary people to begin with; having reached that stage of life, they had more or less all they should, wanting no more than they had and still less willing to lose anything — steadily holding to the status quo was what mattered most to them, and they could bear no more variables.

text: 所以可以动动下半身，但绝对不敢动心。
en: So one may move the lower half, but must never dare to move the heart.

text: 即便心有了要动的迹象，也不会承认并说出来。
en: Even if the heart shows signs of moving, it will not be admitted or spoken aloud.

text: 有时，不是越成熟就越难爱上别人，而是经历的越多就越难分辨摆在眼前的到底是不是爱。
en: Sometimes it is not that the more mature you are, the harder to love another, but that the more you have experienced, the harder to tell whether what lies before you is love at all.

text: 二十几岁的你，可以放心把自己的爱交给一个成熟稳定的男人，却有没有想过：
en: You in your twenties may freely give your love to a mature, steady man, but have you ever thought:

text: 一个三四十岁的男人，有那么容易就能下决心把自己的感情托付给尚很年轻的你吗？
en: would a man in his thirties or forties so easily make up his mind to entrust his feelings to a still very young you?

text: 一旦学会了换位思考，很多之前不理解的事情便都清明了不少。
en: Once you learn to put yourself in another's place, many things you did not understand before become much clearer.

text: 所以，希望大叔控的你能明白，喜欢大叔并不代表你真的适合跟大叔在一起。
en: So, I hope you, with your uncle fixation, will understand: liking older men does not mean you are truly suited to be with one.

text: 至少在奔向大叔之前，你要冷静地想清楚：
en: At least before rushing towards an older man, calmly think through:

text: 你拿什么弥补自己阅历的不足，让他心甘情愿地被你折服？
en: With what will you make up for your lack of experience, so he willingly yields to you?

text: 你能否习惯大叔的生活方式和脾气？
en: Can you get used to an older man's way of life and temper?

text: 你们的心理和生理需求是否处于同一频率？
en: Are your psychological and physical needs on the same wavelength?

text: 哪些东西他能给，够不够用来满足你对这段感情的期许？
en: What can he give, and is it enough to satisfy your hopes for this relationship?

text: 哪些东西他可能给不了，你要不要放低或舍弃一些期待？
en: What might he be unable to give, and will you lower or give up some expectations?

text: 你能否接受并长期“忍受”这种缺乏激情的恋爱？
en: Can you accept and long-'endure' this passion-lacking romance?

text: 你有没有头脑跟大叔斗志斗勇，从他那里获取足够的关注和浪漫？
en: Do you have the wit to match wits with an older man and get enough attention and romance from him?

text: 你的少女心能否驾驭得了一个大叔？
en: Can your girlish heart tame an older man?

text: 你有没有可能在这段感情里得不偿失？
en: Is it possible you would lose more than you gain in this relationship?

text: 嗯，仔细掂量掂量自己，看看你的内心够不够坚韧，想想一旦进入了那样的感情，你到底会不会比现在更开心。
en: Hmm, weigh yourself carefully, see whether your heart is resilient enough, and think: once you enter such a relationship, would you really be happier than now?

text: 尽量客观，使劲理性，想清楚了再做决定——
en: Be as objective as you can, use all your reason, and only decide once you have thought it through —

text: 到时候可别又哭又闹啊。
en: and do not go crying and making a scene when the time comes.

text: 顺便向你推荐我诚意满满的盐选小说↓
en: By the way, let me recommend to you my wholehearted Yanxuan fiction↓

text: 已完结，硬核刑侦悬疑小说，破案细节非常专业。
en: Completed, hardcore crime-fiction suspense novel with highly professional case-solving detail.

text: 双男主，娃娃脸×肌肉男刑警，一文一武完美互补。
en: Dual male leads, baby-face × muscle-man detective, a perfect civil-and-martial complement.

text: 连环凶杀，神秘凶手在下一盘大棋，精彩高智商犯罪！
en: Serial murders, a mysterious killer playing a grand game — brilliant high-IQ crime!

text: 文风、质感跟别的盐选故事不一样！
en: The writing style and texture are unlike other Yanxuan stories!
